title: In JetBrains Hub before 2026.2.52519 two-factor authentication bypass was possible via the password reset flow…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains Hub versions before 2026.2.52519 allowed bypassing two-factor authentication via the password reset flow. This issue could enable an attacker to circumvent the second authentication factor, potentially gaining unauthorized access. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.8, indicating a medium severity. No specific affected versions are listed, and no patch information is provided in the source data.
